info.title: My Little Big Project Planner API
info.description:
REST API of My Little Big Project Planner. The web interface uses this same API.

**Conventions**

- Errors are RFC 9457 Problem Details (`application/problem+json`) with a stable `code`, listed in the `ErrorCode` schema.
- Updates and deletions require `If-Match` with the resource's `ETag` (428 without it, 412 when the resource changed).
- Creations accept an `Idempotency-Key` header: replaying the request does not create a duplicate.
- Lists are paginated with an opaque cursor (`limit`, `cursor`, `nextCursor`).
- `?fields=` selects the returned fields.
- Translated labels follow `Accept-Language`, then the tenant's default language.

**Authentication**

Endpoints need a session unless stated otherwise: sign in with `POST /api/v1/auth/sign-in`, which sets the `mlbpp_session` cookie. Every state-changing request (POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE) must also send the session's CSRF token in the `X-CSRF-Token` header (403 `csrf.invalid` otherwise); it is in the `mlbpp_csrf` cookie and in `GET /api/v1/auth/session`.

post.summary: Enable two-step verification with a first code
post.description: A code from the app proves it holds the secret. Answers 8 backup codes, shown this once. A session waiting for this enrollment becomes complete (new cookies).
Confirmed by a code from the app or a backup code. Refused when the organization requires two-step verification.

204.description: Disabled: secret and backup codes deleted

post.description: Draws a new secret, shown as a QR code and as text. It is only enabled once `POST /account/mfa/confirm` receives a code from the app. Starting again replaces the secret.

200.description: The secret to add to the authenticator app

post.summary: Show an invitation to its invitee
post.description: With the token of the invitation link (in the body, so that it is never logged). For the invitation page.

404.description: `tenant.not_found`

post.description: Joins the tenant with the account of the invitation's email, created with `displayName` and `password` when there is none. An internal member is then signed in under the tenant's policy (two-step verification, SSO). The link works once.

get.summary: Come back from the identity provider
get.description: A browser navigation, the redirect URI registered at the provider. The state must be one this API issued for this tenant, unused and less than 10 minutes old; the ID token is checked (signature, issuer, audience, expiry, nonce). Its verified email must be an active internal member's: a session opens (cookies) and the browser goes to the page it came from. Otherwise, to the sign-in page with `?error=auth.oidc_failed`, `auth.oidc_no_member` or `auth.oidc_email_unverified`.

post.summary: Sign in with email and password
post.description:
Opens a session in the tenant of the request's host: sets the `mlbpp_session` (HttpOnly) and `mlbpp_csrf` cookies. After 5 failures on one email, or many from one address, sign-in is refused for 15 minutes (429). The error never tells whether the email has an account.

When two-step verification is on, or required by the tenant, the session's `stage` is `mfa_challenge` or `mfa_enrollment`: it reaches nothing but the next step, for 5 or 15 minutes.

403.description: `auth.sso_required`: the organization signs this member in through its identity provider

404.description: `tenant.not_found`

post.summary: Complete sign-in with a two-step verification code
post.description: For a session at the `mfa_challenge` stage: a code from the authenticator app, or a backup code, which then cannot be used again. Opens a complete session (new cookies). After 5 wrong codes, the account is blocked 15 minutes (429).

409.description: `conflict`: the session is not waiting for a code

post.description: Ends the session: its cookie no longer works, even if replayed.

204.description: Signed out; the cookies are cleared

get.description: A browser navigation, to the link of `POST /me/switch`. The token must be unused, less than 60 seconds old and issued for this tenant, to an active internal member of it. The tenant's policy applies: when it requires its identity provider, the browser goes to the sign-in page with `?error=auth.sso_required`; otherwise a session opens (cookies) and the browser goes to the application, which asks for a verification code when the account has two-step verification and the session left did not check it. Any other failure: the sign-in page with `?error=auth.switch_failed`.

303.description: Into the application, or to the sign-in page

404.description: `tenant.not_found`

get.description: The account and its role in the current tenant.

post.description: Right to erasure: the account's name, email, password and preferences are removed, it leaves every tenant, and it appears as "Deleted user #N" everywhere, history included. Its content stays, unless `purgeComments`. Needs the password, or for an account without one, a sign-in through the organization's identity provider less than 10 minutes ago; and the email, typed. Ends every session.

204.description: Erased; the session's cookies are cleared

post.description: Right of access: the account, its preferences and memberships in every tenant, and the content it authored, as JSON. Collected in the background: follow the export until it is `ready`, then download it, within 15 minutes.

ErrorCode.description:
Stable error code of a Problem Details response. Clients translate it; it never changes once published.

| Code | Status | Title |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `bad_request` | 400 | The request is malformed |
| `validation_failed` | 400 | The request contains invalid fields |
| `invalid_json` | 400 | The request body is not valid JSON for this operation |
| `invalid_query` | 400 | The query string is invalid |
| `not_found` | 404 | Resource not found |
| `method_not_allowed` | 405 | Method not allowed on this resource |
| `request_timeout` | 408 | The request took too long |
| `conflict` | 409 | The request conflicts with the current state |
| `precondition_failed` | 412 | The resource was modified in the meantime |
| `payload_too_large` | 413 | The request body is too large |
| `unsupported_media_type` | 415 | Unsupported content type; send application/json |
| `precondition_required` | 428 | This request needs an If-Match header |
| `too_many_requests` | 429 | Too many attempts; retry after the delay in Retry-After |
| `internal` | 500 | Internal server error |
| `unauthenticated` | 401 | Sign-in required, or the session has ended |
| `forbidden` | 403 | You are not allowed to do this |
| `csrf.invalid` | 403 | Missing or invalid X-CSRF-Token header |
| `auth.invalid_credentials` | 401 | Incorrect email or password |
| `auth.reset_token_invalid` | 400 | This password reset link is invalid, expired or already used |
| `auth.invalid_code` | 401 | Incorrect or already used verification code |
| `mfa.already_enabled` | 409 | Two-step verification is already enabled |
| `mfa.not_started` | 409 | Start two-step verification setup first |
| `mfa.required_by_policy` | 409 | The organization requires two-step verification |
| `auth.sso_required` | 403 | This organization signs its members in through its identity provider |
| `auth.oidc_failed` | 400 | Sign-in through the identity provider failed; try again |
| `auth.oidc_no_member` | 403 | No member of this organization has this account's email |
| `auth.oidc_email_unverified` | 403 | The identity provider does not vouch for this account's email |
| `auth.switch_failed` | 400 | This switch link is invalid, expired or already used; sign in again |
| `oidc_provider.duplicate` | 409 | This identity provider is already configured |
| `oidc_provider.unreachable` | 502 | The identity provider cannot be reached or answered badly |
| `idempotency_key.invalid` | 400 | The Idempotency-Key header is invalid |
| `idempotency_key.reused` | 422 | This Idempotency-Key was used for a different request |
| `idempotency_key.in_flight` | 409 | A request with this Idempotency-Key is still in progress |
| `tenant.not_found` | 404 | Tenant not found |
| `tenant.slug_taken` | 409 | Another tenant already has this slug |
| `tenant.confirmation_mismatch` | 400 | Type the tenant's slug in `confirm` to delete it |
| `tenant.delete_current` | 409 | The tenant you are signed in to cannot be deleted |
| `reference_item.code_taken` | 409 | Another reference item already has this code |
| `invitation.invalid` | 400 | This invitation link is invalid, expired or already used |
| `invitation.pending` | 409 | This email already has an open invitation; send it again instead |
| `invitation.already_member` | 409 | This email already belongs to a member of the tenant |
| `invitation.closed` | 409 | This invitation was already accepted or revoked |
| `member.last_admin` | 409 | The tenant needs at least one active tenant admin |
| `group.name_taken` | 409 | Another group already has this name |
| `permission.denied` | 403 | You do not have the permission this needs |
| `role.label_taken` | 409 | Another role already has this label |
| `role.in_use` | 409 | Grants use this role: remove them first |
| `account.no_password` | 409 | This account signs in through its organization: it has no password |
| `session.current` | 409 | This is the session of the request: sign out instead |
| `account.reauthentication_required` | 403 | Sign in again through your organization, then erase your account within 10 minutes |
| `account.platform_admin` | 409 | A platform super admin cannot be erased: another one removes the role first |
| `export.pending` | 409 | The export is not ready yet |

What the API returns. `label` is resolved in the request's language.

the tenant's default language, then to any translation; `null` when
the item has no label at all.

version.description: Incremented on every change; the `ETag` is this value in quotes.

Body of `POST` and `PUT`. Unknown fields are refused, so typos are not
silently ignored.

code.description:
2 to 20 characters among `A-Z`, `0-9` and `-`, starting with a letter;
unique in the tenant.

labelTranslations.description: Label per language (`fr`, `en`), at least one; 200 characters at most.

nextCursor.description: Cursor of the next page, `null` on the last page.

grantCount.description: Grants of this role on nodes; a role in use cannot be deleted.

label.description:
In the language of the request (`Accept-Language`), else the
tenant's default, else any.

labelTranslations.description:
One label per language (`fr`, `en`), at least one; 100 characters at
most, unique in the tenant whatever the case.

nextCursor.description: Cursor of the next page, `null` on the last page.

confirmation.description: The account's email, typed to confirm.

password.description:

that signed in through its organization less than 10 minutes ago.

purgeComments.description:
Delete the account's comments too, rather than keep them under the
pseudonym.

csrfToken.description: To send in `X-CSRF-Token` on every state-changing request.

expiresAt.description: The session ends at this time at the latest, or earlier when unused.

stage.description: Only a `complete` session reaches the application.

locale.description: Preferred language; the tenant's default when absent.

tenantId.description: The tenant to switch to: one of `/me/memberships`.

defaultLocale.description: Language used when the request names no supported language.
